content:
The 50 even numbers form a subset with no coprime pair, so \(k>50\).

Pair the numbers as \((1,2),(3,4),\dots,(99,100)\). Each pair consists of consecutive integers, which are coprime. There are 50 pairs, so any 51 chosen numbers must include both numbers from one pair, giving a coprime pair.

Thus the smallest possible value is \(\boxed{51}\).
